title: Reports page access alone opens all six reports with their amounts
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A staff member whose role has only Reports page access opens each of the six reports.
  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access" and nothing else, with "See Financial Data" off.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-04 Reports Only with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST REL-04 Reports Only Role.
  • Each of the six reports has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: the ShopView home page in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) and read the list.
  2. Open A/R Summary.
  3. Open A/R Detail.
  4. Open A/R Collection.
  5. Open A/P Summary.
  6. Open A/P Detail.
  7. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: all six reports are offered.
  • Step 2: A/R Summary opens with its amounts: "See Financial Data" off does not hide them.
  • Step 3: A/R Detail opens with its amounts.
  • Step 4: A/R Collection opens with its amounts.
  • Step 5: A/P Summary opens with its amounts.
  • Step 6: A/P Detail opens with its amounts (the bucket sums).
  • Step 7: A/P Unpaid Invoices opens with its amounts; no setting had to be changed after the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Permissions. Viewing all six reports, and exporting them, is governed by 'Reports → Page Access', unchanged. No new permission is introduced and no existing permission changes. Opening a document from a report uses the permission that already opens that document (see Story 7). The credit term on the A/R Collection call list follows the customer card's rule: only users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch see it, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV (Story 9). Amounts show to everyone who can open the reports, as today and as on Sales By Customer and Inventory Value; 'See Financial Data' does not hide them.”
  • Goals: “Nobody gains or loses access to any data, and no setup is needed.”
  • S1-N1: “If the user lacks 'Reports → Page Access', the reports are not available, as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
